name: Vietnam Solar Fire Safety & Prevention — QCVN 06:2022/BXD & Document 3288/C07-P4 (PCCC)
standard: QCVN 06:2022/BXD (Fire Safety of Buildings and Constructions) + Official Dispatch 3288/C07-P4 (Police Department of Fire Fighting and Rescue - Guidelines on Fire Safety for Rooftop Solar PV) + QCVN 01:2020/BCT (National Electrical Safety)
description: Fire safety and emergency access validation for rooftop solar installations in industrial parks (KCN) and commercial facilities across Vietnam. Enforces Document 3288/C07-P4 requirements: minimum 1.5m perimeter maintenance and firefighter access walkway around roof edges and between panel arrays; maximum continuous panel array dimension of 40m x 40m without an intervening access pathway; Rapid Shutdown or emergency DC disconnecting means located outside or at ground-level for first responders; automatic aerosol or clean agent fire suppression for indoor inverters and transformer substations; earthing resistance R < 4 Ohms per QCVN 01:2020/BCT; lightning protection air terminals per TCVN 9385:2012 / NFC 17-102.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
